assessments.reasoning: The pinned SPDX template/MIT.template.txt URL returned HTTP 200. The whole body reproduced the claimed length and digest. Its optional-section and variable directives survived decoding of the corresponding JSON field. Substituting this exact file for plaintext failed the byte comparison.

The pinned SPDX MIT detail object returned HTTP 200 and its full 8,433-byte body reproduced SHA-256 0c2b3c87a154a4aaac6bc6a735dd454dc29d9a78c23a85deedb080e0c65de1f8. Field selection affected the outcome directly. The complete template equaled decoded standardLicenseTemplate and failed against decoded licenseText in the same object.

The pinned SPDX text/MIT.txt URL returned HTTP 200. Its complete 1,078-byte body reproduced SHA-256 b05785f9f18e6716bab63424b11454513b9943a222595b70411009202fc592b5 and matched the decoded licenseText. It supplied the independent plaintext comparator that rejected the complete template substitution from the first byte.

limitations: The result concerns the exact pinned representations. It establishes neither a formal SPDX matching outcome nor authority to install or redistribute a particular text.
The installation mix-up was tested as a substitution in memory. No installation was inspected. The acquisitions supplied whole files and no named subranges.
